description: Public partition replay (S6 security re-review B1): a request with credentials (user 1) from the public snapshot of page-a got its personal delta page-a -> page-b; a cache that ignores no-store returns it to the request of user 2 without credentials from the same public snapshot (the same U and B). With H-107 alone it was applied and stayed public (H-65); the binding has the nonce of the request of user 1 (bytes 10 to 1F): INTEGRITY_ERROR at step 7 and the public snapshot does not change (H-108)
